records.name: Kazuma Kiryu
records.sourceReference: Kiryu Kiwami 2016 costume and physical Dragon style; project special is an authored physical combination, not a claim to a uniquely named original technique.
records.prompt:
Create ONE new native detailed 2D pixel-art fighting-game BASIC sprite atlas of the SAME fictional game character as the attached accepted 32-pose reference. This is new native drawing, not procedural reuse, not a real actor portrait.
IDENTITY/VERSION: Kazuma Kiryu in Yakuza Kiwami 2016: mature Japanese game character, short black slicked-back hair, light grey suit with matching grey trousers, open-collar burgundy shirt and light shoes. Broad athletic adult build. Empty hands, compact Dragon of Dojima boxing/brawling stance. No weapon.
Use the accepted reference costume and face exactly. Physical body scale must remain consistent across all16cells: standing about190px body in a256pxcell, grounded baseline244; preserve shorter crouching/recoil height. All bodies face RIGHT.
MANDATORY GRID: EXACTLY FOUR COLUMNS by FOUR ROWS, 16 visibly DIFFERENT poses, square1024x1024 transparent RGBA canvas. Four equal independent cells per row. Fully isolated transparent gutters at least18px, every head, weapon, hair, hand and shoe fully contained inside its cell. No limb or bat tip touches a cell boundary. No labels, text, counters, floor, boxes or background.
ROW1 IDLE: four different subtle ready stances: relaxed ready, breathing shoulder lift, slight forward weight transfer, ready stance reset; arms/head/torso genuinely change, not repeated translations.
ROW2 RUN: four different phases of a real run: left foot lead/right arm forward, airborne passing step, right foot lead/left arm forward, back leg gathering. Props stay in hand.
ROW3 ATTACK: Compact physical Dragon of Dojima straight punch: guard, hip turn and extended lead straight punch, body hook chamber, recover. Empty hands, no weapon.
ROW4 HIT: four non-graphic recoil poses: shoulder flinch, torso twists back, low stagger with one arm protecting head, crouched recovery. No cuts/blood, no weapon stabbing the owner.
Sixteen distinct native full-body poses, all same costume, original game identity, all limbs and equipment hand drawn. Compact motion lines may trace the actual limb/weapon but no rays, energy sphere or summoned animal. Render only the sprite art, true alpha background.
